DIAGNOSIS READY: Functional Neurological Disorder (Conversion Disorder)

The combination of normal DaTscan, MRI, and neuropsychological testing alongside the variability in your tremor symptoms strongly suggests a functional neurological disorder rather than a structural or degenerative cause. While the recent memory issues may be related to anxiety or suggestibility, the primary motor symptom is non-organic in nature.
